semantic_notes: All 79 units and both full tables read. All first-pass proposals accepted; one additional precision change aligns the opening mathematical distinction with unit 14.

Mutual non-containment is not disjointness, and heterogeneous domains do not support a widest/narrowest ranking. The four checks and five-trigger ground gate are both non-exhaustive and cannot issue a universal certificate.

The child's nonviolence classification, volume-II cross-reference, same-book assertion and ambiguous Chinese title remain source questions; no invented repair is proposed. All Arendt mediation/narrowing and Sunzi retraction references remain intact.

The ability to refuse remains a derived indicator, never a definition or substitute for the prohibition on using someone merely as a means. Trigger versus verdict, consent limits and all open closing questions are retained.

unresolved_source_questions.finding: The substitution involves beheading, but the claim of passing all four screens rests partly on no violence. The fourth screen is actually about replacing concerted action, not simply presence of violence. Need an author-defined test object and proof; cannot certify the all-four-passed inference.
Cross-reference to a complete treatment of The Prince chapter5 in volume2 is not supported by a full read of frozen if02; no such treatment appears there.
One and the same book is contradicted immediately by references to two separate books.
Chinese title 手在改造握它的人 likely lacks 段. Existing English translates the apparent intended meaning. Preserve title pending confirmation rather than propagate a literal nonsensical reversal.
